# `3PPA`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Three-point polar-alignment progress, from two different producers under one Event name.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, SendPaEvent @0x1626c0, FormatPaStatus @0x161860, ThreePointPaFunc @0x162800, StartPAFunc @0x15fcc0 (64-bit build) |

Two payload contracts share Event 3PPA; select by members, not by name. (1) Function producer (ThreePointPaFunc named 3PPA): Function-state family (SendFuncEvent): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. It adds percent and calib_fail_autogoto in every state, and offset / equ_offset when their components are valid. (2) Polar-align status producer (SendPaEvent then FormatPaStatus), the same structure get_3p_pa_state returns: state is a stage name with state_code; auto_move, auto_update and paused always; detail, lapse_ms, retry_cnt and (with valid offsets) pa_error only when the status active flag is set. Do not validate the status producer's state against the function enum. Top-level total/x/y belong to EqModePA, not to this event. The equatorial (one-point) worker reports as EqModePA instead. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets; start_polar_align also records the calling connection as the recipient of alignment results, and removing that socket stops alignment. Gyro alignment events are not fully audited. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. APK consumer expectation: DTOs declare has_offset and stage members that the inspected formatters do not write.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"3PPA"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Two producers share this member. Function producer: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Polar-align status producer: the stage name for state_code (0=idle, 1=start, 2=exp1, 3=solve1, 4=calc1, 5=move1, 6=delay1, 7=exp2, 8=solve2, 9=calc2, 10=move2, 11=delay2, 12=exp3, 13=solve3, 14=calc3, 15=exp4, 16=solve4, 17=calc4); an unrecognised code gives a shared fallback string. Stage values are retained progress (also after pause) and are never terminal. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`, `exp1`, `solve1`, `calc1`, `move1`, `delay1`, `exp2`, `solve2`, `calc2`, `move2`, `delay2`, `exp3`, `solve3`, `calc3`, `exp4`, `solve4`, `calc4`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started or terminal; status producer: status active flag set | - | Function producer: elapsed milliseconds per the function-state rule. Polar-align status producer: unsigned milliseconds since the stored status start, present when the status active flag is set. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Function producer only: present at fail even when the stored code is 0. No closed list: 207 (guard default), 252 (auto-goto failure) and copied downstream codes are established. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `percent` | number | if function producer, every state | - | Alignment progress percentage. [READ] |
| `calib_fail_autogoto` | boolean | if function producer, every state | - | false when the ordinary offset pair is valid, otherwise the stored flag. [READ] |
| `offset` | array<number> | if function producer, when both components are valid (not the -999 sentinel) | - | Ordinary offset pair; degrees INFERRED. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ; unit INFERRED (degrees)] |
| `equ_offset` | array<number> | if function producer, when both equatorial components are valid (not -999) | - | Equatorial offset pair, gated independently of offset; degrees INFERRED. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ; unit INFERRED (degrees)] |
| `state_code` | integer | if polar-align status producer (always there) | - | Polar-align stage number 0-17 (see state). Not an error code. Range: >= 0. [READ] |
| `auto_move` | boolean | if polar-align status producer (always there) | - | Automatic-move setting of the run. [READ] |
| `auto_update` | boolean | if polar-align status producer (always there) | - | Automatic-update setting of the run. [READ] |
| `paused` | boolean | if polar-align status producer (always there) | - | True when the alignment worker thread is not running. [READ] |
| `retry_cnt` | integer | if polar-align status producer, status active flag set | - | Retry counter of the run. [READ] |
| `detail` | object | if polar-align status producer, status active flag set | - | Per-stage progress. Exposure stages (2, 7, 12, 15): lapse_ms and total_ms. Solve stages (3, 8, 13, 16): lapse_ms and, when non-negative, star_number. Delay stages (6, 11): lapse_ms and total_ms of 4000. Other stages: may be an empty object. No operation or stage member. [READ] |
| `detail.lapse_ms` | integer | no | - | Exposure or wait elapsed, milliseconds. Range: >= 0. [READ] |
| `detail.total_ms` | integer | no | - | Exposure or wait target, milliseconds; 4000 for delay stages. Range: >= 0. [READ] |
| `detail.star_number` | integer | no | - | Stars found by the solver; solve stages only, when non-negative. Range: >= 0. [READ] |
| `pa_error` | object | if polar-align status producer, active flag set and both offsets valid (not -999) | - | Polar-axis error. [READ] |
| `pa_error.total` | number | no | - | Total polar-axis error, degrees. [READ] |
| `pa_error.x` | number | no | - | Error component, degrees. [READ] |
| `pa_error.y` | number | no | - | Error component, degrees. [READ] |
| `pa_error.total_arcsec` | number | no | - | total times 3600. [READ] |
| `pa_error.x_arcsec` | number | no | - | x times 3600. [READ] |
| `pa_error.y_arcsec` | number | no | - | y times 3600. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, status-exposure - Status producer during the second exposure (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"3PPA","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"exp2","state_code":7,"auto_move":true,"auto_update":true,"paused":false,"detail":{"lapse_ms":1500,"total_ms":2000},"lapse_ms":21000,"retry_cnt":0}
```

Event, status-result - Status producer with an error result (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"3PPA","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"calc3","state_code":14,"auto_move":true,"auto_update":true,"paused":false,"detail":{},"lapse_ms":52000,"retry_cnt":1,"pa_error":{"total":0.5,"x":0.3,"y":0.4,"total_arcsec":1800.0,"x_arcsec":1080.0,"y_arcsec":1440.0}}
```

Event, function-working - Function producer (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"3PPA","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":30500,"percent":45.0,"calib_fail_autogoto":false,"offset":[0.25,-0.5]}
```
